changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A review request made in a pull or merge request comment no longer carries the comment's words or its author's login. A stored publication of such a request from an earlier release still holds both, and no erasure reaches it, so this removes the two keys. The listener reads the other keys, which stay.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE event_publication SET serialized_event = (serialized_event::jsonb - 'noteBody' - 'noteAuthor')::text WHERE event_type = 'de.tum.cit.aet.hephaestus.integration.core.events.BotCommandReceivedEvent' AND (serialized_event::jsonb -> 'noteBody' IS NOT NULL OR serialized_event::jsonb -> 'noteAuthor' IS NOT NULL)

rollback.stop: The removed comment words and logins cannot come back. Restore the backup taken before this upgrade to undo it.
